target.description: Research leads relevant to the unresolved aggregate mortality rate of German flak crews.

relay.relayed_by: Mark, then received into GitHub by Codex
relay.notes: The exact model/version, browsing history and source contents consulted by Grok were not independently verified at receipt time. The original contributor reportedly exhausted its free-token allowance and could not post to GitHub.

contribution.summary: The relayed contribution pointed to Westermann, Overmans and Flakhelfer material as stronger research routes and said it had not found support for the viral aggregate 80% mortality claim in the material it examined. It did not propose a replacement number.
contribution.proposed_change: Treat the named works and holdings as research leads only until exact accessible sources/passages are independently checked. Preserve the current mortality rate as unknown.

evidence.label: Edward B. Westermann, Flak: German Anti-Aircraft Defenses, 1914–1945
evidence.notes: Contributor reported consulting summaries, reviews and partial material related to this work; full text was not re-examined page-by-page and exact URLs/passages were absent from the relay.

evidence.label: Rüdiger Overmans, Deutsche militärische Verluste im Zweiten Weltkrieg
evidence.notes: Contributor reported consulting overviews related to this work; full text was not re-examined page-by-page and exact URLs/passages were absent from the relay.

evidence.label: Bundesarchiv-Militärarchiv / personnel and unit-level flak casualty holdings
evidence.notes: Explicitly not consulted by the contributor.

unknowns: The true aggregate mortality rate of German anti-aircraft crews.
Whether the relayed source summaries accurately represented the underlying books.
Whether exact citations were present in the original Grok interface but lost during copying.
